body:
The required software Kerr frame still exceeds 300 seconds. This is a distinct private provider compiler candidate; no gain or adoption is established.

Mesa 25.2.8 `lp_state_cs.c:generate_compute` selects LLVM coroutines whenever `uses_control_barrier` is set. `lp_bld_nir_soa.c:visit_barrier` suspends for every non-NONE execution scope. Changing shader barrier scope alone does not remove this machinery. Removing application execution barriers is not justified.

The existing normal-sum Transport, Endpoint and Dopri shaders use static 16x1x1 workgroups. This CPU supports AVX512, while Mesa caps its default vector policy at 256 bits/eight lanes. A guarded compiler path can evaluate a complete 16-invocation workgroup in one logical LLVM vector, retain each original memory fence and shared/global access, and provide the workgroup rendezvous without coroutine scheduling between vectors. Sirius's 35 shaders, tables, interfaces, arithmetic, all 40 fields, four columns, seven RHS records, three trials and four quartics remain unchanged.

The private patch requires compute, constant 16x1x1 shape, an original control barrier, at most 16 KiB shared storage, default 256-bit vectors, supported 512-bit CPU vectors, only 32-bit/Boolean arithmetic, and no subgroup-sensitive intrinsic or system value. General, dynamic, mesh and unsupported workgroups retain the original lowering. Keep original NIR and all barriers intact: carry an explicit, zero-default context flag into LLVM lowering. Both compute parameter producers set it; all seven existing producers zero-initialise the structure. The provider owns the execution guarantee rather than assuming application lockstep.

Build privately inside this checkout using existing tools and authenticated upstream source. Do not install globally or fabricate properties. Bind matched baseline/candidate compiler inputs and actual provider bytes. Review complete eligibility, control-flow, memory and frame conditions, then inspect ordinary called LLVM code and actual width/shared-memory behavior. Require cross-lane memory/atomic joins plus original arithmetic/provider checks and all eight integrated controls, preserving independent expectations, refusals/recovery and rollback.

Adoption requires the unchanged fixed ABBA once, three internal repeats per slot, all four whole-call gains >=5%, all 16 inclusive stage gains >=-5%, and both provisioning-inclusive API gains >=0%. No pooling, subtraction, weakened settings, retries or adoption from static/JIT facts. Reject on any required failure. Only a surviving integrated candidate justifies the original cold frame.

This does not close #44/#48/#53, full Mandatory/scientific/provider/native/physical/viewer or exact-main installed-release qualification. PR62 stays draft at 6d2af336; main stays 5e706073.

Upstream release and checksum: https://docs.mesa3d.org/relnotes/25.2.8.html . Vulkan subgroup/barrier guarantees are distinct from this provider implementation: https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/shaders.html .
